CustomObject.description: WHAT ANSWERS A SALES-PROCESS QUALIFIER. The seed creates the qualifiers and says in its own comment that the machine-readable mapping from qualifier to answer "belongs to the Process build, not to the seed" - this is that mapping, and it is CONFIGURATION rather than Apex for the same reason the assessment predicates are: LAW #1, a customer org carries its own rubric and its own qualifier text, and a binding compiled into a class would be ours imposed on theirs. Keyed to the qualifier's STORED AltifyId, never its label. An EVIDENCE binding names one or more contract codes and is satisfied by ANY of them, because a qualifier whose own text says "the funds or the person who owns them" is a disjunction and the binding follows the words. A COMPUTED binding names a predicate the ledger evaluates and no contract at all.
